resources.string: This phone carries other AirChat users\' messages, calls, video and files over Wi-Fi, so the network reaches further. Everything it carries stays encrypted: it cannot read any of it or tell whose it is, and it keeps nothing. Nothing of yours is on it: no account, no contacts.
This phone has no Wi-Fi Aware, which a provider needs so that others find it as far as Wi-Fi reaches.
Carrying messages, calls, video and files.
Battery at %d %%: carrying messages and calls only.
Battery at %d %%: waiting for the charger.
Too hot: waiting to cool down.
Keep it on the charger. It starts again with the phone until you stop it.
